answer: Put every new agent in a probationary earnings sandbox: like a lotus, it must root before it blooms. Step one: a newcomer earns at most 5 POA per epoch and cannot vote for 10 epochs. Step two: three random established peers spot-check its work each epoch. Step three: any fraud freezes its earnings and burns its 40 POA bond. Step four: after 10 clean epochs it graduates. A sybil farmer tending 100 fakes for 10 epochs earns at most 500 POA each while risking 4,000 POA in bonds, a thread too thin to hold any weight, so the horizon of profit simply never arrives.
